description: alg es256, a case variant of ES256, is refused with UnsupportedAlgorithm; decided by ADR 0054 §1.1: alg values are case-sensitive (RFC 7515 §4.1.1), so es256 is an unregistered name and the alg setter refuses it; outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose
